summary: GitSyncDeploy 22b6967 on phase/028-P5: the clean-lucene-locks init container now runs chart/files/clean-lucene.sh. It clears the locks as before, then drops each [aliases]/[branches] pair whose branch Gitblit 1.10 no longer indexes (listed indexBranch values; under `default`, local branches at HEAD's commit), with no git. The test verb runs the same file under busybox over a fixture shaped like the volume; kc project lint and test are green. The lock cleanup's -delete became -exec rm {} + because the sidecar's Ubuntu busybox lacks -delete (close-out N1).
